selection: Exact case IDs and source hashes from the pinned 33-file survey; no source rewriting. Explicit genuine dependencies and friend paths; recorded separately from standalone acceptance.

environment.official_jvm_target: 1.8 unless the case records a dependency requirement
environment.candidate_jvm_target: compiler default; emitted class versions recorded per class

limitations: Compile and emitted-class assessment only; this does not establish runtime, whole-module, or Android-device compatibility.
Oracle-generated synthetic and local classes need not have identical names; primary source classes must be emitted.
